build_substrate_definition: build the substrate definition for commons_harvest with a given number of player roles
create_apple_prefab: create an apple prefab with configurable regrowth radius and regrowth probabilities
create_avatar_objects: create a list of avatar game objects for the specified number of players
get_config: get the default training configuration for the commons_harvest level
create_scene: create the scene definition with state manager, neighborhoods, and stochastic episode ending
